common.sentence: 测试负责人建议把旧功能通过回归测试列为发布门槛，发布需晚一天。

language_specific.usage_note: 发布门槛 is a condition that must be met before release.

common.sentence: 为了赶上演示，组长同意先手动部署，但要求下周补自动化。
研究员建议重构数据处理代码，虽要推迟交付，以后修改会更容易。

language_specific.usage_note: 重构 reorganizes code internally while preserving its externally observable behavior; the proposed work would delay this delivery.

common.sentence: 组长决定保留旧接口，虽然维护成本更高，现有用户暂时不用迁移。
团队考虑弃用旧格式，解析代码会更简单，但用户需要时间转换文件。

language_specific.usage_note: Stopping support for the old format would simplify the parsing code but require users to convert files.

common.sentence: 工程师建议加兼容层，让旧客户端继续使用，但代码会更复杂。
团队决定统一数据格式，便于分析，但各来源都需要先做转换。
项目组考虑保留两套协议，迁移更平缓，但测试工作量会增加。
common.meaning: migration to a new system or protocol

language_specific.usage_note: Here 迁移 is the transition from the old protocol to the new one.

common.sentence: 每组只有十份问卷，研究员建议暂不做亚组分析，以免比较失真。

language_specific.usage_note: 亚组分析 examines subsets of the data; the small groups limit the proposed comparison.

common.sentence: 收入空白较多，研究员建议花一天查缺失模式，再决定是否删记录，以免误删有用数据。

language_specific.usage_note: 缺失模式 concerns how missing entries are distributed across the data.

common.sentence: 标注时间有限，组长建议抽样复核，不能因此认定全部标签无误。

language_specific.usage_note: 抽样复核 checks selected items rather than every item.

common.sentence: 只有一周做实验，负责人决定缩小分析范围，先研究新用户。
调查只覆盖线上用户；研究员提醒，结果外推到全体用户须谨慎。
common.meaning: generalize findings beyond the observed group

language_specific.usage_note: 外推 extends findings beyond the observed group; online users may not represent all users.

common.sentence: 只剩两天，研究员建议控制验证成本，先测一组数据，结论仍待检验。
负责人建议增加标注预算，以提高数据质量，但本月不能完成全部样本。
服务器断电虽少见，但恢复时间可能很长；工程师建议演练灾难恢复。

language_specific.usage_note: 灾难恢复 refers to restoring systems or data after a major disruption.

common.sentence: 测试中只有一项报错，组长建议先查影响范围，再决定是否推迟上线。
负责人建议先修数据丢失问题，界面错位虽更常见，后果较轻。
组长决定先向少量用户开放新功能，以控制潜在损失，但其余用户要多等一周。

language_specific.usage_note: 潜在 marks the loss as possible, not as something that has already occurred.

common.sentence: 测试负责人建议增加故障注入，虽要多花两天，却能检验恢复流程。

language_specific.usage_note: 故障注入 deliberately introduces a fault to test how a system responds.

common.sentence: 删除数据前，负责人决定备份以便必要时恢复；备份开销是多占存储空间。

language_specific.usage_note: 开销 refers to resources consumed by the backup; here the stated cost is storage space.

common.sentence: 工程师建议保留旧版本以便出错时回滚，但旧版本会多占存储空间。
common.meaning: roll back to an earlier version

language_specific.usage_note: 回滚 means returning to an earlier version or state after a change.

common.sentence: 负责人要求先演练恢复，因为删除原始数据后恢复代价很高。
组长建议将新功能分批上线，首批出问题就暂停；后续用户需多等一周。

language_specific.usage_note: 分批上线 makes the feature available to successive groups, with a chance to pause between batches.

common.sentence: 外部服务不稳定，工程师建议准备备用方案，但需要额外测试。
永久删除无法撤销，负责人决定先暂停操作，核对文件清单。
本周只有一名工程师，组长把修复登录故障列为最高优先级。
两名标注员本周只能完成一百条，组长决定先处理投诉数据。
测试人手不足，负责人决定暂缓测试次要功能，把时间留给支付流程。

language_specific.usage_note: The team defers lower-priority features to preserve testing time for the payment flow.

common.sentence: 按目前人手估算，团队只能按期完成核心功能，报表需要延期。

language_specific.usage_note: The staffing estimate supports completing the core functionality on schedule while deferring the report feature.

common.sentence: 数据仅覆盖一个月，研究员建议谨慎推广，长期效果尚未验证。

language_specific.usage_note: 谨慎推广 qualifies the recommendation to expand use because longer-term effects remain untested.

common.sentence: 初测中新方案更快，工程师建议继续试用，但内存峰值还有待确认。

language_specific.usage_note: Initial speed tests favor continued trials, while peak memory use remains an unresolved resource cost.

common.sentence: 项目表里写明，小周是数据字典的主责人。

language_specific.usage_note: The primary owner is accountable for the deliverable, though others may contribute.

common.sentence: 接口文档由小王牵头，测试组补充错误码示例。

language_specific.usage_note: The test group contributes error-code examples to the interface documentation led by Xiao Wang.

common.sentence: 报表上线前，小陈负责数据核对，小吴负责页面检查。
模型结果由研究员解释，生产环境部署归运维组管。

language_specific.usage_note: Production deployment belongs to the operations team in this case, while the researcher explains the model results.

common.sentence: 数据库权限由管理员审批，我只能提交申请。

language_specific.usage_note: The administrator approves the permissions; the speaker can submit requests in this case.

common.sentence: 小林离组前，请把训练脚本移交给接手的小赵。

language_specific.usage_note: The training script is to be handed to Xiao Zhao before Xiao Lin leaves the research group.

common.sentence: 小许把写明报表数据来源和更新步骤的交接说明交给接手的小郑。

language_specific.usage_note: The instructions document the information needed by the person taking over the report.

common.sentence: 接手分析前，小郑按交接清单核实数据集是否齐全及版本是否正确。
测试组接收安装包前，请开发组附上运行说明。
双方约定，测试数据和接口文档齐全后再办理交接。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase refers to completing the handover process once the agreed materials are available.

common.sentence: 项目组约定，报表数据与样本一致才算验收通过。

language_specific.usage_note: The project defines a condition for passing acceptance; the sentence does not assert that this report has passed.

common.sentence: 交付前，客户和项目组先确认报表的验收标准。
测试组发现导出缺少表头，暂未签收这版报表。

language_specific.usage_note: The exported report lacks its header, so the testing team has not formally acknowledged receipt of this version.

common.sentence: 客户确认图表无误后，小周在项目记录中登记了验收结果。
报表已交付，但客户还要核对数字，状态暂记为待验收。

language_specific.usage_note: The status distinguishes delivery from the still-pending acceptance review.

common.sentence: 报表的计划交付日期是周五，但数据到达时间未定，还不能对外保证。

language_specific.usage_note: A planned date is a scheduling target, not necessarily a commitment.

common.sentence: 小李对数据清洗的工期估算是三天，但缺失值数量未明，还不能保证。

language_specific.usage_note: The three-day duration is an estimate, with the amount of missing data still uncertain.

common.sentence: 开发组粗算接口改造需两周，查完旧代码再给详细排期。

language_specific.usage_note: The detailed schedule will follow the code inspection; the initial two-week duration is only a rough estimate.

common.sentence: 小周确认资源充足后，才向客户敲定周五的交付日期。

language_specific.usage_note: The delivery date is settled with the client only after resources have been confirmed.

common.sentence: 双方约定的交付期限是月底，小王正在检查安装包。
测试环境只在周二下午开放，项目经理据此安排联调窗口。

language_specific.usage_note: 窗口 refers to the period available for testing connected components together.

common.sentence: 数据供应方尚未开通权限，训练任务因此被阻塞。

language_specific.usage_note: 被 marks the training task as unable to proceed because access is unavailable.

common.sentence: 测试账号还没开通，小陈已向管理员提出解除阻塞的请求。

language_specific.usage_note: The request seeks to remove the obstacle; it does not say access has been granted.

common.sentence: 项目组把完成数据标注定为月底的里程碑。

language_specific.usage_note: Here the term marks a significant project checkpoint.

common.sentence: 标注完成后才能训练模型，项目经理把这段等待计入排期。
数据清洗工期延误两天，依赖清洗结果的模型训练也要晚两天开始。

language_specific.usage_note: The cleaning delay pushes back the dependent training start.

common.sentence: 客户要求增加筛选功能，小王先请项目经理确认变更范围。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase identifies what the requested change covers.

common.sentence: 增加图表会影响周五交付，小陈先与客户协商调整范围。

language_specific.usage_note: The speaker negotiates with the client over the scope after noting a possible delivery impact.

common.sentence: 发现数据可能晚到后，小林在测试组排班前提出调整交期。

language_specific.usage_note: 提出 introduces a proposed change; the sentence does not say it has been approved.

common.sentence: 上线前发现权限问题，小周立即将问题升级至项目经理处理。

language_specific.usage_note: In this professional use, 升级 escalates the issue to the project manager, rather than updating software to a newer version.

common.sentence: 客户同意先交基础报表，新增图表列入下一阶段。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced with fourth tone before the first tone of 阶; its citation tone is shown in the Pinyin.

common.sentence: 客户同意报表改到周五交付，小李发变更通知给测试组调整排班。
小赵完成代码修改后，在任务单上标记完成并附上提交记录。

language_specific.usage_note: The task record reflects completion of the modification, with a code submission as evidence.

common.sentence: 测试通过后，小王把测试报告归档，供客户验收时查阅。

language_specific.usage_note: The test report is archived after the tests pass so the client can consult it during acceptance.

common.sentence: 客户确认报表后，小陈在验收记录中记下了确认时间。
报表已验收，导出速度慢的问题仍未解决，缺陷单由小周跟进。

language_specific.usage_note: The ticket tracks the unresolved export performance issue after the report has been accepted.

common.sentence: 测试报告列出两个遗留问题，小王答应周三前给出处理方案。

language_specific.usage_note: The issues remain unresolved; the commitment is to provide a plan, not necessarily a fix, by Wednesday.

common.sentence: 小李修复导出错误并复测通过后，关闭了对应的任务单。

language_specific.usage_note: 关闭 marks the tracked task as no longer open after the fix passed retesting.

common.sentence: 测试未覆盖旧浏览器，小陈在交付记录中注明待补测。

language_specific.usage_note: The status records that the omitted browser coverage still needs testing.

common.sentence: 接口文档已交付，小林请测试组反馈是否具备联调条件。
common.meaning: meet the conditions for joint integration testing

language_specific.usage_note: The question asks whether the necessary conditions for joint testing are met; delivery alone does not establish that they are.

common.sentence: 我告诉新人：审计日志记录谁在何时修改了权限。

language_specific.usage_note: The audit log records actions relevant to accountability, including permission changes.

common.sentence: 给新人看报错信息时，我指出堆栈里显示了出错前的调用路径。

language_specific.usage_note: Here 堆栈 refers to call-chain information displayed with an error report, not a complete execution log.

common.sentence: 我向实习生解释：断点让程序在指定位置暂停，方便检查变量。

language_specific.usage_note: A breakpoint marks a place where execution pauses during debugging.

common.sentence: 新人问为什么保存失败，我指出文件权限不允许这个账号写入。

language_specific.usage_note: 写入 refers to putting data into a file; the account lacks permission to do so.

common.sentence: 我向新人演示：这次版本回退让程序恢复旧版，当前数据保留。

language_specific.usage_note: Data retention is a feature of this particular operation, not a guarantee of every version reversion.

common.sentence: 我告诉新人：异地备份把副本存在另一城市，以防本地故障。

language_specific.usage_note: The copy is stored at another site to protect against local failure; recovery is not guaranteed.

common.sentence: 我告诉新同事：加密后，没密钥的人不能直接读懂文件内容。

language_specific.usage_note: Encryption transforms the file content so it cannot be directly understood without the key.

common.sentence: 我给新人看数据库：主键用于在表中唯一标识每一条记录。

language_specific.usage_note: A primary key can span multiple columns; its combination of values is unique, and its columns cannot be null.

common.sentence: 我教新人多条件筛选：订单须同时满足已付款和本周提交。

language_specific.usage_note: Both stated conditions must hold for an order to be selected.

common.sentence: 我提醒新人，空值表示这里没有记录数据，不能当作零。

language_specific.usage_note: 空值 marks the absence of a recorded value; it is distinct from the numeric value zero.

common.sentence: 我告诉经理：订单每天夜里定时离线处理，次日才能看结果。

language_specific.usage_note: Here processing runs as a scheduled job without a user waiting for an immediate result; it need not be disconnected from the network.

common.sentence: 我告诉经理：试用白名单上只有甲、乙两家店，其他店暂不能使用。

language_specific.usage_note: The list identifies the stores currently permitted to use the trial.

common.sentence: 我告诉客服主管：维护期间启用只读模式，用户可浏览但不能提交订单。
我告诉店长：库存同步间隔为五分钟，变动可能不会立即显示。

language_specific.usage_note: The interval is the time between updates, so displayed stock can lag behind changes.

common.sentence: 我告诉客服：密码重置链接一小时后失效，用户需重新申请。

language_specific.usage_note: This service’s password reset link expires after one hour and must then be requested again.

common.sentence: 我向主管说明：重复提交会生成两笔订单，用户需要取消一笔。

language_specific.usage_note: The stated consequence concerns this ordering system, not every system.

common.sentence: 我告诉经理：账号配额是一千个，已用八百个，还能新增两百个。

language_specific.usage_note: The quota sets the maximum number of accounts available in this system.

common.sentence: 我给客服主管的故障通报写明：手机用户不能登录，电脑用户不受影响。

language_specific.usage_note: The report communicates the incident and identifies affected and unaffected users.

common.sentence: 我告诉经理：服务恢复后，积压的订单还需要半小时处理。

language_specific.usage_note: 积压 describes orders that accumulated while processing could not keep up.

common.sentence: 我告诉客服：本系统退出后清除会话状态，筛选条件重置，账号数据保留。

language_specific.usage_note: 会话状态 refers to information maintained for a session, such as the current filter selection in this system.

common.sentence: 我告诉经理：十条登录记录涉及六个账号，按账号去重计数得六。

language_specific.usage_note: 去重计数 counts each account once even if it appears in multiple records.

common.sentence: 我向经理说明：调查只覆盖工作日，顾客周末的情况未纳入。

language_specific.usage_note: 覆盖 specifies the scope of the survey, here the days on which it was conducted.

common.sentence: 我向经理说明：转化率从百分之十升至十五，相对增幅为百分之五十。

language_specific.usage_note: The five-percentage-point increase is half the original rate, giving a relative increase of fifty percent.

common.sentence: 向经理汇报时，我强调关联：本次数据中等待越久，退款越多。

language_specific.usage_note: 关联 describes a relationship observed in these data; it does not establish causation.

common.sentence: 我告诉经理：订单金额多数较低，少数很高，形成右尾较长的偏态分布。

language_specific.usage_note: 偏态分布 is asymmetric; the distribution described here has a longer right tail.

common.sentence: 我告诉主管：同一订单池反复等量随机抽样，各次均值的分布叫抽样分布。

language_specific.usage_note: Here the sampling distribution concerns sample means from repeated random samples of the same size, not individual order values.

common.sentence: 我告诉经理：预测的情景假设是门店数不变，扩店后需重算。

language_specific.usage_note: The prediction is calculated for a scenario in which the number of stores stays fixed.

common.sentence: 我告诉产品经理：一百名访客中十人购买，转化率是百分之十。

language_specific.usage_note: Here the rate is the share of visitors who purchased.

common.sentence: 我告诉经理：订单虽增长，测试仍未确定新版页面的增量效果。

language_specific.usage_note: This is the additional effect attributable to the new page; observed order growth alone does not establish it.

common.sentence: 我向经理说明：初步结果显示订单增多，完整数据下周才能核实。

language_specific.usage_note: 初步 marks the result as provisional pending further data and verification.

common.sentence: 给新研究员介绍数据时，我指出缺失率：十份问卷有两份没填年龄。

language_specific.usage_note: Here the rate concerns missing age responses, not missing questionnaires as a whole.

common.sentence: 我告诉经理：一家店的结果能否适用于其他店，尚不确定，这涉及外部效度。

language_specific.usage_note: External validity concerns how far findings apply beyond the setting studied.

common.sentence: 我教新同事系统抽样：随机选起点，之后每隔九条记录选一条。

language_specific.usage_note: A random starting point is followed by a fixed selection interval; this does not guarantee a representative sample.

common.sentence: 我提醒经理：预测误差是预测值与实际值之差，正负都有可能。

language_specific.usage_note: Prediction error measures the discrepancy between a predicted value and the observation; the stated difference is signed.

common.sentence: 我告诉客服：请求超时是客户端等待时间已到，服务端是否处理仍未知。

language_specific.usage_note: The client's waiting limit has expired; that alone does not establish whether the server processed the request.

common.sentence: 向经理汇报时，我先讲业务影响：故障使订单确认晚了两小时。

language_specific.usage_note: 业务影响 frames the incident in terms of its consequence for the operation.

common.sentence: 给新同事交接时，我列出排查顺序：先看网络，再查服务状态。

language_specific.usage_note: 排查顺序 specifies the order in which possible sources of a problem should be checked.

common.sentence: 经理问能否今天修好，我说还要复现故障，目前无法承诺时间。

language_specific.usage_note: 复现故障 means causing the same fault to occur again under observable conditions.

common.sentence: 我向产品经理确认：这里的“活跃”指当天登录，还是完成下单？

language_specific.usage_note: The question checks which observable action defines an active user for this metric.

common.sentence: 向主管汇报时，我把结论限定在测试环境：正式环境尚未验证。

language_specific.usage_note: The test environment is the setting where the result was observed; production has not yet been checked.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论：影片在童年、中年和少年时期之间反复跳转，采用了非线性叙事。

language_specific.usage_note: Events are presented outside a straightforward chronological sequence.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论时，小林说，片中女孩望向窗外，随后展现她所见街景的画面是主观镜头。

language_specific.usage_note: The shot presents what a character sees, rather than showing the character from outside.

common.sentence: 电影讨论会上，小林说影片结束时，女孩还站在车站，去留未定，是开放式结局。

language_specific.usage_note: The film ends without resolving the character's choice, leaving the outcome open to interpretation.

common.sentence: 观影会上大家讨论：影片没交代父女为何分开，留下了叙事空白。

language_specific.usage_note: A relevant event or explanation is left unstated in the story.

common.sentence: 影迷会认为，片头那把锁为后面发现密室埋下了伏笔。
common.meaning: early detail preparing for a later development

language_specific.usage_note: 埋下伏笔 describes a detail presented early that gains relevance later.

common.sentence: 观影会上，小林说信封直到结尾才打开，这个悬念留得很久。
影迷会上，小林说影片揭晓司机就是失主后，她对前情的理解变了。

language_specific.usage_note: 揭晓 introduces the previously withheld fact that the driver is the owner who lost the item.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论：观众已见门外的贼，女孩却不知情，这是戏剧反讽。

language_specific.usage_note: The audience knows a significant fact that a character does not.

common.sentence: 观影会上，小王说镜头只拍到男孩能看到的门缝。

language_specific.usage_note: Here 镜头 refers to a segment of film, not the physical camera lens.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论时，有人称那幅只拍手中旧照片的画面为特写。

language_specific.usage_note: In film discussion, 特写 shows a subject or detail at a large scale within the frame.

common.sentence: 观影会上，小周提到远景里的人很小，山谷却占了大半画面。
common.meaning: long shot showing a broad area

language_specific.usage_note: This film term describes shot scale, with a broad setting visible.

common.sentence: 影迷会说这场对话用了中景，两人的上半身都在画面里。

language_specific.usage_note: A medium shot commonly shows a person from around the waist up.

common.sentence: 观影会上，大家发现全景中演员从头到脚都能看见。

language_specific.usage_note: Here the shot includes the actor's entire body within the frame.

common.sentence: 影迷会聊到构图：空桌占据画面中央，母亲坐在边缘。

language_specific.usage_note: This refers to the arrangement of visible elements within the image.

common.sentence: 观影会上有人指出，分屏让两地通电话的人同时出现在画面左右。

language_specific.usage_note: Separate images occupy different areas of the screen at the same time.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论时，女孩走出画框，声音却还在。

language_specific.usage_note: Here 画框 means the limits of the screen image, not a physical picture frame.

common.sentence: 观影会成员说，那只伸进画面的手暗示画外还有人。

language_specific.usage_note: 画外 refers to space beyond the visible image; the member's inference is based on the hand.

common.sentence: 影迷会上，小陈指出镜头从高处俯拍了院子里的孩子。

language_specific.usage_note: The camera looks downward toward its subject; the angle has no fixed meaning.

common.sentence: 观影会上，有人注意到镜头仰拍屋顶，连烟囱也入了画。

language_specific.usage_note: The camera looks upward toward its subject; the angle has no fixed meaning.

common.sentence: 影迷会聊到，镜头向右摇拍，依次扫过站台上的乘客。

language_specific.usage_note: Here the camera turns horizontally while its position remains fixed.

common.sentence: 观影会上，小李说镜头向上摇，画面从井口移到了树梢。

language_specific.usage_note: The camera turns vertically upward; it need not move from its position.

common.sentence: 影迷会注意到摄影机沿走廊移动，跟拍提灯的老人。

language_specific.usage_note: The camera follows the elderly person; the sentence explicitly states that the camera moves along the corridor.

common.sentence: 观影会成员发现摄影机没动，只用变焦让远处的钟变大。

language_specific.usage_note: The lens changes focal length; this is distinct from moving the camera closer.

common.sentence: 影迷会指出，浅焦画面里前面的杯子清楚，后面的人模糊。

language_specific.usage_note: Only a relatively narrow range of distances appears sharp.

common.sentence: 观影会上，大家发现深焦画面里近处的花和远处的人都清楚。

language_specific.usage_note: A relatively broad range of distances appears sharp.

common.sentence: 影迷会注意到焦点从桌上的信转到后面的母亲脸上。

language_specific.usage_note: The focus shifts between objects at different distances within the shot.

common.sentence: 观影会上，小孙指出洗碗戏持续了好几分钟，中间没有切换，是长镜头。

language_specific.usage_note: 长 refers to the duration of an uninterrupted shot, not the camera's distance from its subject.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论时，小赵说画面从关门直接切到第二天的街道。

language_specific.usage_note: 切到 introduces the image that follows an edit.

common.sentence: 观影会成员说，两人争吵时，影片在他们的脸之间来回切换。

language_specific.usage_note: Here the film alternates between shots of the two speakers.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论剪辑：修桥和运木头的场面交替出现。

language_specific.usage_note: 剪辑 includes selecting and arranging shots; here it is the subject of discussion.

common.sentence: 观影会上，小吴说前一镜头拍人抬脚，后一镜头接着拍落脚，这是动作匹配。

language_specific.usage_note: The edit joins shots at corresponding points in a continuous action.

common.sentence: 影迷会发现两个镜头接不上：杯子刚在左手，转眼就在右手。
common.meaning: fail to match across an edit

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: Citation 不 is bù; it is normally weak and neutral-toned in the potential complement 接不上 in connected speech.
language_specific.usage_note: The phrase describes a mismatch between consecutive shots.

common.sentence: 观影会讨论时，有人指出两次敲门之间省略了人物走下楼的过程。
common.meaning: leave out part of an action

language_specific.usage_note: The film omits an intervening action rather than showing it in full.

common.sentence: 影迷会说，院子的画面淡出后，又淡入空荡的车站。

language_specific.usage_note: The image gradually disappears, often into black.

common.sentence: 观影会上，小郑说黑屏后淡入的厨房已经布满灰尘。

language_specific.usage_note: The image gradually appears from a dark or blank screen.

common.sentence: 影迷会注意到，旧画面还在时火车声已响起，随后才出现车站，这是声音先入。
common.meaning: sound leading into the next shot

language_specific.usage_note: Sound associated with the next image begins before the picture changes.

common.sentence: 观影会上，小林指出画面中收音机里的歌是画内音，角色也听得见。
common.meaning: sound from a visible source in the scene

language_specific.usage_note: The radio producing the song is visible within the image.

common.sentence: 影迷会上，小陈说女孩在屋里时，屋外传来喊她名字的画外音，画面没显示说话人。

language_specific.usage_note: Here the voice belongs to someone in the scene who is outside the visible frame.

common.sentence: 观影会上，有人说雨停后配乐响起，让她觉得结尾有了希望。

language_specific.usage_note: The viewer's response is an interpretation of this particular scene, not a fixed effect of music.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论这处声画分离：画面是空街，声音却是屋内的争吵。

language_specific.usage_note: The sound and image present different actions or spaces rather than matching directly.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小周说：“你推开门”采用了第二人称。

language_specific.usage_note: The narrative addresses a figure as 你; that figure need not be the actual reader.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小陈说：这一段写阿明听见锁响，叙述视角跟随他的经历。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase concerns the position from which events and knowledge are presented.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小何说：“我从未去过海边，去年在那里游过泳”或许出自不可靠叙述者。

language_specific.usage_note: The narrator's account may be unreliable because its two claims conflict.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小林说，小说交替写姐姐寻人、弟弟逃亡，两条线索交错推进。

language_specific.usage_note: Here the two narrative strands alternate as their events develop.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小吴说：“我从不撒谎”与叙述者承认骗过人相矛盾。

language_specific.usage_note: A与B相矛盾 identifies two claims that cannot both hold as stated.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小赵分析话语层次：叙述者说母亲转述叔叔的话：“船明天走。”

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase refers to the nested attribution from narrator to mother to uncle.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小许说，“她想，门怎么锁了”写出了人物的内心活动。
读书会上，小杨说：“我”从叫父亲“爸爸”到叫“父亲”，称呼变化或许暗示疏远。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 呼 is neutral-toned in 称呼.
language_specific.usage_note: The phrase refers to a shift in how someone is addressed; the implied distance is the reader's tentative interpretation.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小郑说，妹妹藏起哥哥认错的信，或许是在袒护他。

language_specific.usage_note: The proposed reading is that she shields him from blame by hiding his admission.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小宋说：父亲把伞留给女儿，这处行为描写流露出他的体贴。
common.note: The reader interprets the father's action as considerate.

language_specific.usage_note: This term refers to depicting a character through observable actions.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小杜说，她撕了邀请函，可能是为了回避见面。
读书会上，小马猜，弟弟弄坏钟后偷偷修好，是出于愧疚。

language_specific.usage_note: 出于愧疚 presents guilt as the reader's proposed motive.

common.sentence: 读书会里，小秦认为，“你总算来了”暗含了等待时的不满。

language_specific.usage_note: The proposed feeling is suggested indirectly rather than stated outright.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小叶说，她答应帮忙却迟迟不动，言行之间有矛盾。
读书会上，小沈认为，母亲反复问“冷不冷”是在试探女儿是否愿意说话。

language_specific.usage_note: The question is read as an indirect attempt to gauge the daughter's willingness to talk.

common.sentence: 读书会里，小陶说，兄弟俩争吵后仍一起修车，关系并未完全破裂。
读书会上，小周说，“月亮是银盘”中，月亮是本体。
common.meaning: thing being compared in a metaphor

language_specific.usage_note: In this comparison, 本体 names the thing described through another image.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小陈说，“群山是沉睡的巨兽”中，巨兽是喻体。
common.meaning: image used for comparison in a metaphor

language_specific.usage_note: 喻体 names the image used to describe the thing being compared.

common.sentence: 读书会里，小何把反复出现的旧钥匙视为贯穿故事的意象。

language_specific.usage_note: A concrete detail is treated as an image that acquires significance in the text.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小林认为，离别前后的两次空椅描写构成了关联。

language_specific.usage_note: The reader identifies a connection between two descriptions without specifying a fixed symbolic meaning.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小吴说，开头的灯和结尾归家时的灯形成首尾关联。

language_specific.usage_note: 首尾 refers to the opening and ending of the text.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小赵把落叶看作告别，小许看作新生，两人有阐释分歧。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase identifies differing interpretations of the same detail.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小许说，热闹的街市与独坐的人形成对照。

language_specific.usage_note: 形成对照 presents two details side by side to bring out a difference.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小杨说，“冷雨贴着脸”这样的感官描写让场景更真切。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase describes writing that evokes sensory experience, here the feel of cold rain.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小郑说，“墙上的影子吞没了桌子”让画面显得压抑。

language_specific.usage_note: 压抑 describes the oppressive atmosphere the reader finds in the image.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小宋说：文中一句“三年过去了”带过三年，叙述节奏很快。

language_specific.usage_note: Here it refers to the perceived pace of the narration.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小杜说，先写葬礼再写童年，打乱了事件的时间顺序。

language_specific.usage_note: The order in which events happened differs from the order in which they are narrated.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小马说，候车情节被童年回忆打断，随后又回到候车这条主线。

language_specific.usage_note: Here 主线 refers to the main sequence of events at the station.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小秦说，结尾只写“门开了”，没有交代是谁开的门，这是叙述省略。

language_specific.usage_note: The narration leaves out the identity of the person who opened the door.

common.sentence: 读书会里，小叶说，结尾停在“她抬起手”，是否敲门留给读者想象。
common.meaning: leave for the reader to imagine

language_specific.usage_note: The text leaves an outcome unstated, inviting the reader to imagine it.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小沈说，客人迟到后被称为“守时的人”，语带讽刺。

language_specific.usage_note: 语带讽刺 describes the reader's sense that the apparent praise mocks the late guest.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小陶说，“您请坐”比“坐下吧”语气更客气。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 气 is neutral-toned in 客气.
language_specific.usage_note: The reader compares the courtesy conveyed by the two invitations.

common.sentence: 读书会里，小周觉得“哟，您可来了”语气里带着埋怨。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 埋 is read mán in 埋怨.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小陈认为，“雨停了，人走了”这样的短句显得冷静。
读书会上，小何认为，“回来吧”一再出现，增强了恳求的语气。
读书会上，小林认为，“要是当时开口就好了”表达了人物的遗憾。

language_specific.usage_note: The character wishes they had spoken, suggesting regret about not doing so.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小吴说，结尾她拿起行李却坐回原处，这一突转令人意外。

language_specific.usage_note: The term highlights an abrupt change in the expected direction of events.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小赵做用词分析：“攥着信”的“攥”或许透出不舍。

language_specific.usage_note: The analysis considers how the specific verb 攥 contributes to a possible interpretation.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小许说，她关窗也许为挡风，小赵猜是为避开邻居，动机归因不同。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase refers to assigning a proposed motive to an action.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小杨说，“她笑了”并不等于她原谅了对方。

language_specific.usage_note: The construction rejects treating the smile and forgiveness as equivalent.

common.sentence: 影迷会赞赏这部电影的改编策略：把书中日记变成画面。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase refers to a choice about how to transform source material for another medium.

common.sentence: 读书会认为电影删去她为何离家的解释，动机铺陈不足。

language_specific.usage_note: This phrase concerns how a work develops and presents a character's reasons for acting.

common.sentence: 影迷会认为，改编版把独白换成沉默的特写，很有表现力。
读书会说，书和电影都以父亲归家结尾，电影提前揭晓，忠于原著却少了悬念。
common.meaning: be faithful to the original work

language_specific.usage_note: This evaluates an adaptation's adherence to its source, without implying that faithfulness alone makes it successful.

common.sentence: 影迷讨论改编时，认为新加的妹妹让家庭冲突更有层次。

language_specific.usage_note: Here 有层次 praises the conflict for having several distinguishable aspects.

common.sentence: 影迷会认为电影略去三次寻人，有效压缩了情节。

language_specific.usage_note: Here 压缩 means shortening narrative material, rather than physically compressing an object.

common.sentence: 读书会称赞这句告别含而不露：“门口的灯我会留着。”
common.meaning: convey something without stating it openly

language_specific.usage_note: The promise about the light suggests attachment without directly naming the feeling.

idiom_support.contemporary: A feeling or meaning is suggested without being openly stated.
idiom_support.collocations: Use in expressions such as 感情含而不露 or 含而不露的表达.
idiom_support.register: Neutral to literary, especially in criticism.
idiom_support.avoid: Avoid it when the feeling is explicitly stated or no underlying meaning is apparent.

common.sentence: 影迷会说，新结尾把姐妹重逢改成通电话，削弱了情感冲击。
影迷会称赞雨声后的寂静，认为氛围营造很细腻。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase refers to artistic choices that create a particular mood.

common.sentence: 影迷会上，小周称赞逃亡画面配轻快舞曲的声画对位。
common.meaning: expressive counterpoint between sound and image

language_specific.usage_note: The term describes an expressive relationship between sound and image, here built on contrast.

common.sentence: 读书会认为，贯穿全篇的钟声使小说的等待主题更鲜明。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase describes an element that recurs or extends throughout a work.

common.sentence: 影迷会上，小林说母亲反复念着儿子的名字，那一幕情感浓度很高。

language_specific.usage_note: This figurative expression evaluates how intensely emotion comes across in a scene.

common.sentence: 影迷会嫌旁白说“人人都该孝顺”太直接，说教意味太重。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase criticizes an expression for seeming to lecture the audience about proper behavior.

common.sentence: 读书会欣赏小说的多重视点：两位邻居对争吵各有说法。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase refers to presenting events through more than one viewpoint.

common.sentence: 影迷会上，小周说近景只拍到狭窄的灶台，让厨房显得逼仄。
影迷会上，有人批评配乐盖过了演员低声说出的台词。
影迷会提醒新人：影片不解释人物关系，观影门槛较高。
common.meaning: barrier to understanding or engaging with a film

language_specific.usage_note: 门槛 is figurative: it refers to the knowledge or effort a viewer may need.

common.sentence: 影迷会建议放映时加字幕，让听障观众也能参与讨论。

language_specific.usage_note: 听障 is a concise form of 听力障碍, used here to describe audience members.

common.sentence: 读书会认为，注释解释了方言，降低了新读者的阅读门槛。

language_specific.usage_note: 门槛 is figurative here: it refers to the difficulty a reader must overcome.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论排片：热门片票房虽高，小片也需要放映机会。
影迷会认为加打斗戏可能有商业考量，但削弱了人物对话。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase identifies a possible market-related consideration, not a proven intention.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论海报时说，海报只宣传笑点，掩盖了影片的悲剧色彩。

language_specific.usage_note: 色彩 figuratively describes a quality or tone present in the work.

common.sentence: 影迷会上，小陈赞赏结尾未定去留，给了她想象空间。

language_specific.usage_note: The unresolved choice lets this viewer imagine possible outcomes.

common.sentence: 读书会说，封面上的粉色爱心虽醒目，却容易让人误以为战争小说讲的是爱情。
影迷会称赞影片让清洁工讲述自己的日常，而非只作背景。

language_specific.usage_note: Here the phrase criticizes treating a person as scenery rather than a developed character.

common.sentence: 读书会觉得，小说让父亲既会失约也会道歉，人物更立体。

language_specific.usage_note: Applied to a character, 立体 praises the portrayal for showing several facets.

common.sentence: 影迷会上，小林批评老板只会发怒，人物过于类型化。

language_specific.usage_note: Here 类型化 criticizes reducing the character to a predictable type; the term does not make every use of character types artistically unsuccessful.

common.sentence: 读书会认为，女儿自己决定留下并阻止了拆迁，体现了角色能动性。

language_specific.usage_note: This phrase evaluates a character's capacity to make choices that affect events.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论送餐员的故事，认为等单的细节很有真实感。

language_specific.usage_note: 真实感 describes an impression of realism, not proof that a scene records actual events.

common.sentence: 读书会批评小说只写租客争吵，房租上涨的社会语境缺席了。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase refers to social conditions relevant to interpreting the conflict.

common.sentence: 影迷会上，小陈称赞影片保留普通话和粤语，展现了语言多样性。
读书会赞赏祖孙各说想搬与想留，觉得小说给了双方对话空间。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase describes room for both positions to be voiced within the work.

common.sentence: 影迷会上，小陈说影片里一家人晾衣服的场景很有生活质感。
common.meaning: a tangible sense of everyday life

language_specific.usage_note: This figurative phrase praises a portrayal for making everyday life feel tangible.

common.sentence: 读书会讨论结尾的关门：有人读作解脱，有人读作逃避，理解差异明显。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase names the difference between the two readers' interpretations of the same closing-door detail.

common.sentence: 影迷会觉得告别时突然响起的弦乐，情绪渲染过重。
common.meaning: intensification of emotion through artistic means

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase refers to using an artistic device to intensify an emotional effect.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论争吵戏，有人觉得表演太夸张，反而难以共情。
读书会赞赏小说写出邻居双方的难处，没有急于道德裁决。
common.meaning: moral judgment assigning right and wrong

language_specific.usage_note: Here the phrase refers to a definitive judgment about which party is morally right.

common.sentence: 影迷会上，有人认为重复的关门声强化了离别的主题。
读书会讨论结尾时，有人质疑和解来得太突然，缺少铺垫。

language_specific.usage_note: In narrative criticism, 铺垫 refers to earlier material that prepares for a later development.

common.sentence: 影迷会赞赏影片中一家人边包饺子边争论，认为文化再现具体。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase concerns how the film depicts a particular family's practice, not a claim about all families.

common.sentence: 影评会上，小林批评影片草率收尾：两人刚和好就结束了。
common.meaning: bring to an insufficiently developed close

language_specific.usage_note: The criticism concerns how quickly the film ends after the reconciliation.

common.sentence: 读书会上，小陈说人物突然离家，前文对此预示不足。
common.meaning: give insufficient indication of a later event

language_specific.usage_note: Members decide for themselves whether to read aloud or only listen.

common.sentence: 老吴家吃饭时不劝菜，他解释说客人自己取就好。
common.meaning: urge someone to eat a dish

language_specific.usage_note: 劝菜 means encouraging a guest to eat food; the stated preference belongs to this household.

common.sentence: 朋友家聚会通常结束得晚，这次大家另行约定九点结束。

language_specific.usage_note: 另行 marks the agreed finish time as a separate arrangement for this gathering.

common.sentence: 读书会规定邀约未回复不算拒绝；组织者暂留名额，问对方是否收到邀请。

language_specific.usage_note: The place is held provisionally; the invitee's attendance is not confirmed.

common.sentence: 影友会主持人说，电影结束后大家可以自行离场，不必留下讨论。

language_specific.usage_note: The host allows attendees to leave after the film rather than stay for the discussion.

common.sentence: 队员没说为何缺席晚餐，志愿队长劝大家别妄加揣测。

language_specific.usage_note: With 别, the expression cautions against guessing at the member's reasons without evidence.

idiom_support.collocations: Often used with cautions such as 别妄加揣测 or 不要妄加揣测.
idiom_support.avoid: Avoid it for a supported inference or a harmless, clearly identified guess.

common.sentence: 朋友家不收客人带的菜，我问过她的待客习惯后便没带菜。

language_specific.usage_note: The practice being asked about is this friend's household preference concerning food brought by guests.

common.sentence: 读书会每人准备一段朗读，新人提出分享感想作为变通方案。

language_specific.usage_note: The proposed alternative adapts the usual reading activity; it is not presented as already accepted.

common.sentence: 志愿队原先只在线报名，为照顾不用手机的队员，也接受电话报名。

language_specific.usage_note: 照顾 here means taking particular participants' needs into account.

common.sentence: 朋友家聚餐轮值掌厨，每次换人做饭，我便问何时轮到我。

language_specific.usage_note: 轮值 marks a rotating responsibility; 掌厨 means being in charge of cooking.

common.sentence: 影友会主持人提议按愿不愿听结局分组讨论，免得有人被剧透。

language_specific.usage_note: The proposed grouping separates those willing to hear the ending from those who do not want to hear it.

common.sentence: 外婆问这次“拼单”怎么买，我说：咱们合并下单，一起分运费。

language_specific.usage_note: The buyers place one combined order for this purchase; the sentence does not promise cheaper shipping.

common.sentence: 小林问书市“轮值”是什么意思，周叔说：志愿者按表轮流值班。

language_specific.usage_note: The volunteers take turns according to the schedule.

common.sentence: 阿姨问顺位候补是什么意思，我说：有空位时，按名单顺序等候补上。
common.meaning: wait for an available place in list order

language_specific.usage_note: The waiting order determines who can fill a place when one opens.

common.sentence: 小陈问保留席位是什么意思，奶奶说：这个座位给你留着，别人不坐。

language_specific.usage_note: The seat is kept available for a particular person.

common.sentence: 爷爷问顺延一天是什么意思，我说：就是从周五推迟到周六。

language_specific.usage_note: The scheduled date moves one day later.
language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is normally pronounced yì before the first-tone 天.

common.sentence: 小赵问“代领”怎么说得明白，李叔说：替别人领取。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 人 is neutral-toned in 别人.
language_specific.usage_note: The person collecting the item acts for its intended recipient.

common.sentence: 奶奶问“自费”是什么，我说：费用要自己出。

language_specific.usage_note: 出 means to provide or pay the stated expense.

common.sentence: 小许问社区服务“就近办”在哪儿，王姨说：在家门口就能办。

language_specific.usage_note: Here 家门口 means nearby, not literally at the door.

common.sentence: 志愿书市上，爷爷问：“未结事项是啥？”小乔说：“就是还没做完的事，比如登记。”

language_specific.usage_note: This administrative phrase means matters not yet completed; the reply gives registration as an example.

common.sentence: 陈姨问临时代班是什么意思，小刘说：我替小周值班，直到他回来。

language_specific.usage_note: The speaker covers the absent volunteer's shift for a limited time.

common.sentence: 小林问通知里“暂缓办书市”是取消吗，赵姨说：先搁着。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 着 is neutral-toned.
language_specific.usage_note: This spoken expression puts the plan on hold without saying it is canceled.

common.sentence: 周叔问逐条查验怎么做，小孟说：拿名单对着登记册，一条条检查。

language_specific.usage_note: Each list entry is checked against the register.

common.sentence: 小吴问公告里的逐案处理是什么意思，陈姨说：每份申请都要分别处理。

language_specific.usage_note: Each application is handled separately.

common.sentence: 王叔问“物资短缺”怎么说简单些，小孙说：物资不够。
小周问试用工具后怎么回传意见，李姨说：把用后的想法发回给我们。

language_specific.usage_note: The comments are sent back to the speaker's group.

common.sentence: 小郑问物资怎么按需领用，刘叔说：需要多少就领多少。
common.meaning: take supplies according to the quantity needed

language_specific.usage_note: The amount taken depends on the amount needed.

common.sentence: 王叔问文件“备份”是什么意思，小顾说：另存一份，原件丢了还能恢复。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced yí before the fourth-tone 份; its citation tone is yī.
language_specific.usage_note: The separate copy can be used to recover the file if the original is lost.

common.sentence: 小叶问程序“回滚”怎么做，陈工说：退回旧版。

language_specific.usage_note: The program returns to an earlier version; the wording makes no claim about retained data.

common.sentence: 刘姐问程序“报错”时屏幕上是什么，小谢说：那是错误提示。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase refers to the displayed message, not necessarily the cause of the error.

common.sentence: 小宋问研究组的“抽样框”是什么，赵老师说：就是挑选参与者的登记名单。

language_specific.usage_note: This registered list supplies the people from whom participants are selected.

common.sentence: 孙姨问参与者代号是什么，小杜说：研究记录里用它代替参与者的姓名。

language_specific.usage_note: A code is used in place of a participant's name in the record.

common.sentence: 小田问功能“上线”怎么说得清楚，张工说：正式启用，用户可以用了。

language_specific.usage_note: The feature is made available for users to use.

common.sentence: 吴叔问怎么再现故障，小罗说：重复当时的操作步骤，让故障再次出现。

language_specific.usage_note: The relevant steps are repeated to make the fault occur again.

common.sentence: 小林问表格里“待录入”是什么意思，王姐说：纸上的数据还没输进电脑。

language_specific.usage_note: The data exist on paper but have not yet been entered into the computer.

common.sentence: 影友小丁问“闪回”，周姨说：影片暂时回到更早发生的事。

language_specific.usage_note: The film briefly presents events from an earlier time.

common.sentence: 影友王叔问“解说词”是什么意思，小梁说：就是配着画面讲解的文字。

language_specific.usage_note: The term names words explaining the footage; it does not specify whether the speaker appears on screen.

common.sentence: 小梅问读书会说的“伏笔”，赵姨说：前面埋下线索，后面用上。

language_specific.usage_note: An early detail becomes relevant to a later development.

common.sentence: 李姨问影评里的未明言是什么意思，小周说：影片故意不说人去哪儿，让观众自己想。

language_specific.usage_note: The film deliberately leaves the destination unstated for viewers to interpret.

common.sentence: 小方问这段“叙述立足点”是啥，孙叔说：这段从孩子的角度写他听到的脚步声。

language_specific.usage_note: The observation concerns the child's perception in this passage, not necessarily the whole work.

common.sentence: 影友陈叔问“重映”，小袁说：这部老电影再次放映。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 重 is read chóng in 重映.

common.sentence: 小方以为奶奶答应了，我说：“尽量来”的承诺强度比一定来弱。

language_specific.usage_note: 尽量来 expresses an intention to try, which is weaker than a firm promise to attend.

common.sentence: 小周以为张叔今晚必到；我说：他说“看情况”，还没定。
common.meaning: depend on how things turn out

language_specific.usage_note: The speaker leaves attendance conditional rather than committing to come.

common.sentence: 李姨以为活动取消了，小郑说：通知说“延期”，择日再办，日期未定。
common.meaning: hold at a later date to be chosen

language_specific.usage_note: The event is postponed and its replacement date remains open.

common.sentence: 小陆以为测试全过了，王工说：两项通过是阶段性结果，其余还没测。

language_specific.usage_note: The result covers the two tests passed so far; the remaining tests have not been run.

common.sentence: 周姨以为要买十把椅子；小何说：我说的是“大约十把”。

language_specific.usage_note: The quantity is an estimate, not an exact count.

common.sentence: 小许以为陈姨命令他休息；我说：她说“歇会儿吧”，是在建议。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 会儿 is pronounced huìr, and 吧 is neutral-toned.
language_specific.usage_note: Here 吧 softens the suggestion to take a brief rest.

common.sentence: 王奶奶问预约时“选择时段”是什么意思，小林说：选个时间段，我给您分步讲解。

language_specific.usage_note: 小林 offers to explain the appointment process in stages.

common.sentence: 王叔问这次安排要“报备”是什么意思，小冯说：告诉负责人，留个记录。

language_specific.usage_note: The arrangement is reported to the person in charge so that there is a record.

common.sentence: 小叶以为都修好了，李姐说：验证范围只有这台，故障已消失，其他的没测。

language_specific.usage_note: The fault disappeared on the tested device; the others were not tested.

common.sentence: 小林问通知里的“逾期不受理”是什么意思，周姨说：截止后提交的申请不予办理。
common.meaning: late applications will not be accepted for processing

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced bú before the fourth-tone syllable 受; its citation form is bù.
language_specific.usage_note: The notice excludes late applications from processing.

common.sentence: 志愿队安排送餐时，小林提出先送行动不便的老人。

language_specific.usage_note: The proposal is presented for consideration; 提出 does not mean the team has adopted it.

common.sentence: 读书会选场地，小周提议优先考虑离地铁近的地方。
项目组选数据库，小王建议比较两种方案前先确定评判标准，比如成本。
电影社选放映时间，周六更符合多数成员的时间安排。
志愿队比较两条送药路线，安全性是首要标准。
数据组按多样性和成本量化评分：甲采样方案八分，乙方案六分。

language_specific.usage_note: The group assigns numerical scores to the sampling plans using the stated criteria.

common.sentence: 邻里小组商量聚餐，餐馆虽近，但包间费用偏高。

language_specific.usage_note: 偏 softens the assessment while indicating that the cost exceeds what the speaker considers suitable.

common.sentence: 电影社选影片时，小陈建议把片长也纳入考虑。
项目组讨论发布时间，小李认为周五上线比周四风险更大。
志愿队选仓库，小赵提议用排除法，先去掉租金超预算的。

language_specific.usage_note: The group would narrow its choices by eliminating warehouses that exceed the budget.

common.sentence: 读书会安排分享顺序，主持人问大家对抽签有无异议。

language_specific.usage_note: The host asks participants to state objections; the question itself does not establish agreement.

common.sentence: 社区义卖要借学校场地，队长请小刘提出疑点，比如学校允许使用到几点。

language_specific.usage_note: The captain invites an unresolved point, here the permitted end time for using the school venue.

common.sentence: 项目组商量删减功能，小周不尽赞同，担心影响老用户。

language_specific.usage_note: Xiao Zhou expresses qualified disagreement without necessarily blocking the group's eventual decision.

common.sentence: 电影社选片时，小林对放恐怖片持异议，因为有成员不敢看。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase states Xiao Lin's disagreement with the proposed screening.

common.sentence: 志愿队讨论改送餐时间，队长说沉默不等于同意，请大家表态。

language_specific.usage_note: The team explicitly distinguishes a lack of response from agreement.

common.sentence: 聚餐地点还没定，阿姨问：“公园附近和车站附近，大家更中意哪个？”

language_specific.usage_note: The question asks which location people like better without settling the choice.

common.sentence: 数据组讨论清洗规则时，小王提醒大家听听不同意见。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced bù before the second tone of 同.

common.sentence: 电影社讨论增加场次，小周说她暂时赞成，须先确认场地。

language_specific.usage_note: The support is provisional; venue confirmation is still required.

common.sentence: 志愿队商量夜间巡查，提过照明问题后，小李请大家补充意见。

language_specific.usage_note: Xiao Li invites further input after the lighting concern has been raised.

common.sentence: 项目组讨论迁移数据，组长请小陈说明反对的理由。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced with a neutral tone.

common.sentence: 电影社约定选片按票数决定，这次喜剧片获得多数票。

language_specific.usage_note: A majority does not imply that every voter supported the film.

common.sentence: 读书会约定全员赞成才换场地，这次提议未获一致赞成。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced yí before the fourth tone of 致 in connected speech.
language_specific.usage_note: The phrase describes support from everyone, as required by this group's stated agreement.

common.sentence: 志愿队约定半数成员到场才能投票，今天到场人数未过半。

language_specific.usage_note: The attendance may be exactly half; the sentence does not establish whether the team's threshold was met.

common.sentence: 项目组约定发布方案的最终审批权归负责人，测试员只提建议。

language_specific.usage_note: The team assigns authority to approve the release plan to its lead.

common.sentence: 志愿队集体审议雨衣采购方案，最终数量由队长决定。

language_specific.usage_note: The members consider the proposal together; the captain decides the final quantity.

common.sentence: 数据组约定抽样比例由组长批准，研究员的建议还待批准。

language_specific.usage_note: The recommendation has been made but has not yet received the designated approval.

common.sentence: 读书会约定选书先讨论再投票，目前还在讨论阶段。

language_specific.usage_note: The stated process has not yet reached its voting stage.

common.sentence: 邻里小组约定选活动地点先举手表决，票数相同再讨论。
common.meaning: vote by a show of hands

language_specific.usage_note: This is the decision method chosen by this group.

common.sentence: 项目组选测试工具，按约定投票后，两种工具票数相同。
志愿队约定选队服按多数票，蓝色方案以六票对四票通过。

language_specific.usage_note: The stated vote satisfies this team's chosen majority rule, so the proposal is adopted.

common.sentence: 电影社通过的决议要点：周日放短片，周五前确认场地。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase introduces the main points of the adopted decision, including the venue follow-up deadline.

common.sentence: 项目组议定修复登录问题，执行人是小赵，周三检查进度。

language_specific.usage_note: The noun identifies Xiao Zhao as the person who will carry out the agreed repair.

common.sentence: 志愿队决定先小范围开展早班送餐，一个月后评估是否继续。

language_specific.usage_note: The early delivery service will initially cover a limited scope, with continuation assessed after a month.

common.sentence: 读书会定好本月线上聚会；下月场地列为再议事项。
common.meaning: matter set aside for later discussion

language_specific.usage_note: The venue for next month remains to be discussed; this month's online meeting is settled.

common.sentence: 数据组决定将异常值保留待查，核实来源后再处理。

language_specific.usage_note: The values remain in place while their source is checked; they are not automatically treated as errors.

common.sentence: 邻里小组定了聚餐日期，阿姨负责在周五前通知各家。
项目组记录：新接口附条件采纳，测试须达标，小林跟进。

language_specific.usage_note: Adoption of the interface is conditional on meeting the test standard.

common.sentence: 志愿队决定周末清理河岸，小陈把分工记入会议记录。
电影社决定租小厅，小王先核实价格，超出预算就重新讨论。

language_specific.usage_note: Exceeding the budget triggers a return to discussion under the stated arrangement.

common.sentence: 读书会决定借图书馆办活动，由小李联系馆方并反馈结果。
项目组先用模拟数据验证流程，再用真实数据测试。

language_specific.usage_note: This refers to data generated for a test rather than collected from the real situation.

common.sentence: 数据组删掉重复记录后，样本量减少了。

language_specific.usage_note: Here 记录 refers to entries in a dataset; 重复 identifies entries representing the same record.

common.sentence: 研究组核对表格：年龄是未填项，次数填的是零。

language_specific.usage_note: An unfilled field has no entry; zero is an entered value.

common.sentence: 软件组发现报错的触发条件是点击保存；修复办法还在查。

language_specific.usage_note: The condition describes what causes the fault to occur, not how to repair it.

common.sentence: 软件组做了配置还原：超时设回三秒，程序版本不变。

language_specific.usage_note: The previous configuration is restored without replacing the program version.

common.sentence: 数据组先把访谈记录匿名化，再共享给项目成员。

language_specific.usage_note: In this workflow, the interview records are processed to remove information that identifies participants before sharing.

common.sentence: 研究组报告的是相关性，不能据此断定因果关系。

language_specific.usage_note: 相关性 describes an association between variables; it does not by itself establish causation.

common.sentence: 项目组的交付预估是下月中旬，日期还可能变。

language_specific.usage_note: The estimated delivery time is tentative rather than a promised date.

common.sentence: 志愿队活动报名二十人，实到人数是十六人。

language_specific.usage_note: This count records those who attended, rather than everyone who registered.

common.sentence: 小林是志愿队与场地方的联络窗口，双方通过她商量开门时间。

language_specific.usage_note: The designated contact coordinates communication and need not make the final decision.

common.sentence: 志愿队还缺两名司机，队长决定继续招募。

language_specific.usage_note: 招募 seeks people to join a task or group; it does not mean assigning an existing member.

common.sentence: 志愿队正在发水，另留应急储备，防止天气太热时缺水。

language_specific.usage_note: The reserve is held for a possible emergency, separate from the water currently being distributed.

common.sentence: 志愿队的排班草案中，小周负责早班，还等大家确认。

language_specific.usage_note: The proposed shifts remain open to confirmation.

common.sentence: 志愿队分段配送：东街、西街各一段，都在上午送。

language_specific.usage_note: The route is divided geographically; the two sections are not separate time batches.

common.sentence: 影迷会发现，画外音讲述了镜头没拍到的往事。

language_specific.usage_note: 画外音 is a voice heard while its source is not shown in the image.

common.sentence: 影迷会说影片只拍他出门和到站，中间有情节空缺，并非前后矛盾。

language_specific.usage_note: The intervening events are unstated; that alone does not establish a contradiction.

common.sentence: 读书会发现叙事时序先写归家，再写出走；出走其实在先。
common.meaning: order of presentation in a narrative

language_specific.usage_note: The order in which events are presented differs here from the order in which they occurred.

common.sentence: 读书会说“雨后泥土的气味”是感官意象，不是抽象评价。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase evokes a particular smell rather than stating an abstract judgment.

common.sentence: 影迷会区分演员的表演和角色在故事中的选择。

language_specific.usage_note: 表演 refers to the actor's performance, distinct from the fictional character's decisions.

common.sentence: 读书会注意到“我怕黑”的叙事声音属于故事里的孩子，不是作者。

language_specific.usage_note: The words are presented in the fictional child's voice, which is distinct from the real author.

common.sentence: 项目组今天的讨论范围是接口，是否延期下次决定。

language_specific.usage_note: 范围 identifies what the present discussion covers; the decision about delay is deferred.

common.sentence: 研究组提到样本偏少，便以“还需补充调查”收束论述。
common.meaning: bring a discussion to a close

language_specific.usage_note: The closing statement follows the group's stated concern about the sample.

common.sentence: 志愿队面临的问题是车辆不足，队长正在联系司机。

language_specific.usage_note: This phrase introduces the difficulty facing the group, before the sentence describes a response.

common.sentence: 数据组的论证链条是：两次结果差距大，须重测以核实。

language_specific.usage_note: The observed discrepancy supports the recommendation to repeat the test for verification.

common.sentence: 影迷会并置比较两种看法：长镜头自然，长镜头也可能拖慢节奏。
common.meaning: compare by placing side by side

language_specific.usage_note: The two views are presented alongside each other for comparison.

common.sentence: 读书会认为结尾温暖，附带说明：这只针对最后一幕。

language_specific.usage_note: The added statement limits the assessment to the final scene.

common.sentence: 软件组先记录报错，下一步是检查日志。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced with second tone before the fourth-tone 步; the Pinyin gives its citation tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 下一步 identifies the action to follow the step already stated.

common.sentence: 新志愿者知道地点，却问怎么签到；队长按需展开，讲了扫码签到。

language_specific.usage_note: The leader expands on the point the new volunteers asked about.

common.sentence: 项目组分清主次：先修登录故障，配色下周再议。

language_specific.usage_note: The team gives the login fault priority and defers the color discussion.

common.sentence: 研究组说明适用边界：这次调查的结论只涉及受访的本校学生。

language_specific.usage_note: The conclusion concerns the interviewed students at this school, without extending it to all students.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论的是镜头长度，而不是影片票房。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced with second tone before the fourth-tone 是; the Pinyin gives its citation tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 而不是 contrasts the actual topic with one that is excluded.

common.sentence: 志愿队的建议是分两批送餐，避免一辆车装不下。

language_specific.usage_note: 建议 introduces a proposed action; the final clause gives its practical purpose.

common.sentence: 读书会说主角眷恋故土；通俗地说，就是他舍不得家乡。

language_specific.usage_note: The second wording expresses the same interpretation in more familiar language.
language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 地 is neutral-toned.

common.sentence: 志愿队想知道每日报名数，数据组用图示说明每天的变化。

language_specific.usage_note: The chart organizes the explanation around the daily counts the volunteers requested.

common.sentence: 项目组暂不扩大测试，原因是目前人手不足。

language_specific.usage_note: 原因 introduces the stated reason for postponing a wider test.

common.sentence: 影迷会谈完声音后转入下一议题，讨论画面灯光。
common.meaning: move to the next agenda item

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced yí before the fourth-tone syllable 议.
language_specific.usage_note: The phrase marks the close of one agenda topic and the start of another.

common.sentence: 研究组指出一个限制：受访者都来自同一所学校。

language_specific.usage_note: 限制 identifies a feature of the study that qualifies how broadly its findings can be interpreted.

common.sentence: 新志愿者问雨天在哪集合，队长有针对性地说明：改到大厅。
common.meaning: give an explanation tailored to the question

language_specific.usage_note: The explanation addresses the volunteers' specific question about rain.
language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 地 is neutral-toned.

common.sentence: 读书会的分歧所在是旧伞：一人说象征牵挂，一人说只是道具。

language_specific.usage_note: The disagreement concerns whether the umbrella carries symbolic meaning.

common.sentence: 软件组总结了测试结果：登录正常，导出仍有错误。

language_specific.usage_note: 总结 introduces a concise account of the results, including both the successful and unresolved parts.

common.sentence: 我对朋友说：“你只迟到过一次，我说你总迟到，措辞过火了。”

language_specific.usage_note: The speaker acknowledges that the wording was too strong for what happened.

common.sentence: 志愿者小林说方案是小周提的，我赶紧更正：是我提的。

language_specific.usage_note: 更正 introduces a correction to the stated attribution.

common.sentence: 读书会里，我把小陈的疑问误当成反对；她其实是在求证。

language_specific.usage_note: 把 A 误当成 B acknowledges that A was mistakenly interpreted as B.

common.sentence: 得知朋友手机坏了，我向她承认：之前猜她故意躲着我，是我误会她了。

language_specific.usage_note: With a person as its object, 误会 means judging that person or their intentions wrongly; the speaker acknowledges the mistake.

common.sentence: 项目组里，我说“数据都错了”，说重了：只有两行有误。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 了 is neutral-toned.
language_specific.usage_note: 说重了 acknowledges that the preceding assessment was too strong.

common.sentence: 影迷会里我说他故意剧透，后来才知道他以为大家都看过。

language_specific.usage_note: 才 marks the information as learned later than the earlier accusation.

common.sentence: 我跟朋友消除误会：“我不是嫌你来晚，是担心你路上出事。”

language_specific.usage_note: The speaker corrects the friend's interpretation and explains the actual concern.

common.sentence: 志愿队说我负责采购，我纠正一下：我只负责登记。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 has a rising surface tone before the fourth-tone 下; the citation form is yī.
language_specific.usage_note: 一下 softens the correction of the speaker's assigned role.

common.sentence: 项目组以为我答应修全部错误，我说：我承诺的是修登录问题。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is neutral-toned.
language_specific.usage_note: 承诺的是 identifies the actual content of a commitment and can correct an overbroad account.

common.sentence: 读书会里我说结尾仓促，并不是说整本书都不好。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced with a rising surface tone before the fourth-tone 是; its citation tone is bù.
language_specific.usage_note: 并不是说 rejects an overly broad inference from the preceding criticism.

common.sentence: 朋友说搬箱子太吃力，我问：要不要一起搬？
common.meaning: would you like to do it together

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: In this A-not-A question, 不 is commonly unstressed and neutral-toned (bu); citation bù is retained in the Pinyin. 一 in 一起 surfaces as yì before the third-tone 起.
language_specific.usage_note: The offer leaves the other person free to accept or decline help.

common.sentence: 志愿者说排班表难懂，我说：我们换个方式看，好吗？

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 个 is neutral-toned.
language_specific.usage_note: The inclusive 我们 frames the change as a shared adjustment.

common.sentence: 同事说分不清图表颜色，我调整说明方式，改用不同线型并解释各自代表什么。
影迷说没听清台词，我说：刚才声音太小，我再放一遍。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 has a rising surface tone before the fourth-tone 遍; its citation tone is yī.
language_specific.usage_note: The speaker offers to replay the line after recognizing the low volume.

common.sentence: 朋友以为我不想见面，我解释说这周连上夜班，无暇赴约。
common.meaning: have no time to meet as arranged

language_specific.usage_note: This formal phrase attributes the missed meeting to a lack of time.

common.sentence: 数据组里，我说样本有偏差；严格来说，是招募方式可能有偏。

language_specific.usage_note: 严格来说 introduces a more precise formulation of the earlier claim.

common.sentence: 队友以为小王不愿帮忙，我解释：他上班和志愿任务时间冲突。

language_specific.usage_note: The phrase identifies an overlap between work and the volunteer task.

common.sentence: 读书会以为我推荐了整套书，我澄清推荐范围仅限第一册。

language_specific.usage_note: The scope is restricted to the first volume, correcting the broader interpretation.

common.sentence: 项目组以为小李拍板，我解释：他提建议，决定权在组长。

language_specific.usage_note: 决定权 distinguishes the person authorized to decide from the person offering advice.

common.sentence: 朋友说我批评她不细心，我解释：我针对的是这次安排，不是你。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is neutral-toned.
language_specific.usage_note: 针对的是 identifies the actual object of the criticism and separates it from the person.

common.sentence: 朋友以为我拒绝见面，我重读“今天”：“今天不行，明天可以。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 今天 receives contrastive prominence, limiting the refusal to today and leaving tomorrow open.

common.sentence: 志愿队分工时，我重读“先”：“先登记，再发物资。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 先 is stressed in this delivery, highlighting the order of the two tasks.

common.sentence: 项目组讨论进度，我重读“暂时”：“暂时能用，还得测试。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 暂时 is prominent, qualifying usability as provisional rather than established by testing.

common.sentence: 影迷会里我重读“画面”：“画面很美，故事却有些散。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 画面 is stressed, separating praise for the visuals from the following criticism of the story.

common.sentence: 读书会里我说：“结尾很安静。”停顿后接：“反而更有力。”
common.meaning: is all the more powerful for it

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: The pause before 反而更有力 separates the observation from the speaker's unexpected evaluation.
language_specific.usage_note: 反而 marks the evaluation as contrary to an implied expectation that a quiet ending would be less powerful.

common.sentence: 朋友担心打扰我，我重读“愿意”：“我愿意听，你慢慢说。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: Stress on 愿意 makes the offer of attention explicit in response to the friend's concern.

common.sentence: 志愿队讨论人手，我重读“还能”：“我周六还能来，周日不行。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 还能 is stressed to foreground continued availability on Saturday, contrasted with Sunday.

common.sentence: 数据组开会，我重读“可能”：“可能有偏差，还需复核。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 可能 is stressed, foregrounding uncertainty before the proposed verification.

common.sentence: 影迷会讨论结局，我说：“我猜他回家了，”稍停，“但影片没有明说。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: The pause before 但影片没有明说 separates the speaker's guess from the limitation in the film's evidence.

common.sentence: 朋友借书时，我重读“这本”：“这本可以借，那本我要用。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 这本 receives contrastive stress, distinguishing the available book from the other one.

common.sentence: 志愿队商量送餐，我重读“顺路”：“我顺路送，不用你绕远。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: Stress on 顺路 presents the offer as fitting the speaker's route, in contrast to the other's detour.

common.sentence: 项目组问能否上线，我重读“还”：“还不能上线，安全测试没过。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 还 is stressed to foreground that the restriction applies for now; the failed test supplies the reason.

common.sentence: 读书会里我重读“我”：“我读着有点难，想听听大家的看法。”
common.meaning: I find it a little difficult to read

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 我 is stressed to locate the difficulty in the speaker's experience; 着 is neutral-toned.

common.sentence: 朋友商量聚会，我说：“地方不远，”停顿后接，“就是有点吵。”
common.meaning: the drawback is that it is a little noisy

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: The pause before 就是有点吵 separates the favorable location from the following reservation.
language_specific.usage_note: 就是 introduces a qualification to the preceding favorable point.

common.sentence: 数据组讨论结果，我重读“这批”：“这批数据可靠，别的还没查。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 这批 is stressed to restrict the reliability claim to the batch identified, contrasting it with unchecked data.

common.sentence: 影迷会里我重读“也”：“配乐也重要，画面不是全部。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 也 is stressed to add the music to the discussion alongside the visuals.

common.sentence: 志愿队问我何时交表，我重读“争取”：“我争取周三交，周二太赶。”
common.meaning: aim to submit it on Wednesday

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 争取 is stressed, presenting Wednesday as an aim rather than a guaranteed submission.
language_specific.usage_note: 争取 expresses an effort toward the stated deadline.

common.sentence: 朋友要帮我搬家，我重读“已经”：“车已经找好了，箱子还缺。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 已经 is stressed to mark the vehicle as arranged, contrasting it with the boxes still needed; 了 is neutral-toned.

common.sentence: 项目组评审时，我说：“方案可行，”稍停，“前提是预算够。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: The pause before 前提是 makes the budget condition a distinct qualification to the feasibility claim.
language_specific.usage_note: 前提是 introduces a condition on which the preceding assessment depends.

common.sentence: 读书会讨论人物，我重读“未必”：“他未必冷漠，也许只是不善表达。”

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence: 未必 is stressed to question a definite judgment of indifference while leaving room for another interpretation.
language_specific.usage_note: 未必 rejects certainty; it does not assert that the character is definitely warm.
